title: Implement Undo Redo in Sketchpad Store
description: Implement undo/redo in the sketchpad store using the existing transaction/edit architecture. Integrate into the real store/command mutation path with reversible do/undo diffs. Tests for commit, multi-step merge, abort rollback, redo invalidation, and undo/redo boundaries.
summary: Fixed bug in createKeyedTransactionHandlers and createSingleKeyTransactionHandlers where fresh-start TRANSACTION.START incorrectly cleared redoStack. Only commit/recordEdit should clear redo - matching PlainAppStore.startTransaction() behavior. Added 19 vitest unit tests for transaction undo/redo contract: single commit, multi-step merge, empty tx ignored, abort rollback, undo/redo movement, redo invalidation, boundaries, fresh start preserves redo, nested auto-finalize, symmetric cycles, kit diff roundtrip. All 174 tests pass.
